regex/replace#

Matches of a pattern replaced in a text.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

RegexSubstitution(origin: text, regex: Regex("\\s+"), replacing: LiteralRegexReplacement(" ")).string();
let swapped = RegexSubstitution(
    origin: "Ada Lovelace",
    regex: Regex("(?<first>\\w+) (?<last>\\w+)"),
    replacing: ExpandedRegexReplacement("${last}, ${first}"),
).string();                                          // "Lovelace, Ada"

Description#

Matches of a pattern replaced in a text.

Regex.replaced(origin:, by:) is the short form for a literal replacement.
